@@U04731@@
How swiftly then the foot that slips
slides to its destruction.
Fervent glances, flattering lips,
lead to heart’s seduction.

@@U04732@@
(The MATER GLORIOSA soars into view.)

@@U04734@@
You who rise soaring
to regions eternal,
hear our imploring,
great vision supernal,
you without rival,
give us your grace!

@@U04736@@
By my love that
bent in weeping
over your son,
divinely born,
wetting His feet with
tears of balsam
despite all Pharisaic scorn;
by that jar that
poured in reverence
precious ointment
so profusely,
by my hair that
dried those sacred
limbs, that fell
around them loosely—

@@U04738@@
By that well,
that ancient station
where Father Abram’s
flocks were led;
by the pail that
wet the parched lips
translation:
@@U04731@@
那脚滑得有多快
滑向其毁灭。
热情的目光，谄媚的嘴唇，
引起心灵的诱惑。

@@U04732@@
（荣耀女神号翱翔在视野中。）

@@U04734@@
腾飞的你
到永恒的地区，
聆听我们的恳求，
伟大的愿景超凡，
没有对手的你，
请赐予我们您的恩典！

@@U04736@@
以我的爱
弯腰哭泣
越过你的儿子，
神圣诞生，
弄湿他的脚
香脂的眼泪
尽管有法利赛人的蔑视；
通过那个罐子
倾注敬意
珍贵的药膏
如此丰富，
通过我的头发
干燥那些神圣的
摔倒的四肢
松散地围绕着他们——

@@U04738@@
借着那口井，
那个古老的车站
亚伯兰神父所在的地方
羊群被引导；
通过桶
湿润干燥的嘴唇
